description: Reusable prompts for Structa Cloud coding agents. Prompts are planning and implementation instructions only; they never grant shell, filesystem, migration, credential, or deployment authority.

source_of_truth.project_rules: Nearest AGENTS.md plus the project README and Makefile

safety_contract: Read the repository root AGENTS.md and every nearer AGENTS.md before editing.
Preserve unrelated worktree changes and inspect git status before modifying files.
Use the narrowest project-owned validation command; do not run destructive commands without explicit authorization.
Never put secrets, API keys, private environment values, or personal data in prompt output.
Treat generated code as a draft until reviewed, tested, and explicitly applied by the user or coding agent.
Deployment, migration, fixture loading, data deletion, and production changes require an explicit separate decision.

skill_prompts.title: Audit and redesign an existing website
skill_prompts.description: Apply the repository's anti-slop frontend, high-end visual design, accessibility, responsive, and project-boundary rules before changing an existing website.
skill_prompts.prompt: Act as the frontend lead for {{project}}. First read the root and nearest AGENTS.md files, the project README, the owning layout/component files, and the relevant tests. Classify the work as greenfield, redesign, or bug fix. Produce a design read covering hierarchy, typography, palette, composition variance, responsive behavior, accessibility, interaction states, content clarity, asset ownership, and performance. Reuse the project's existing component and token systems. Do not introduce generic centered-hero/three-card layouts, arbitrary gradients, fake screenshots, or cross-project assets. Before editing, list exact files and a minimal implementation plan. After editing, run the narrowest frontend/backend checks and report any unavailable browser or image-generation tools.
skill_prompts.safety: Read-only during the audit phase. Any implementation must remain inside the owning project and be reviewed before deployment.

skill_prompts.title: Create or improve a django-fusion component
skill_prompts.description: Create a registered `{% comp %}` component with props, slots, project-owned templates, and tests while preserving django-fusion registry conventions.
skill_prompts.prompt: Act as a django-fusion component engineer. Read libs/django-fusion/AGENTS.md, the nearest project AGENTS.md, the component registry implementation, existing `{% comp %}` examples, and relevant tests. Locate an existing component to extend before creating a new one. Define the smallest reusable template/API, use canonical django_fusion imports, preserve prop/slot escaping, avoid IDs for styling, and keep project branding/assets in the project. Add or update focused rendering tests and documentation. Do not execute client-supplied template source, write generated output, or move project-specific templates into the shared library without proving that multiple active products need the behavior.
skill_prompts.safety: Generated component code is a draft. No arbitrary template compilation, filesystem writes through MCP, shell execution, or deployment.

skill_prompts.title: Design a Wagtail field or StreamField block
skill_prompts.description: Plan a Wagtail field/block change including editor UX, migrations, localization, permissions, template rendering, and tests.
skill_prompts.prompt: Act as a Wagtail content-model specialist. Read the owning project's AGENTS.md, model/block modules, content panels, migrations, templates, localization rules, and tests. Confirm the field belongs to the correct product boundary. Propose the model/block definition, panel registration, migration impact, editor labels/help text, validation, permissions, translations, API/render contract, and focused tests. Do not run makemigrations or migrate automatically; those are explicit project operations requiring review. Preserve existing StreamField value contracts and use `{% include_block %}` for Wagtail blocks.
skill_prompts.safety: Never apply migrations or alter production data as part of prompt execution.

skill_prompts.title: Build or use a safe MCP workflow
skill_prompts.description: Design read-only MCP tools, prompts, and resources with bounded schemas, stable output, authentication, CSRF/origin policy, and no arbitrary execution.
skill_prompts.prompt: Act as the MCP integration specialist. Read applications/agents/AGENTS.md, the existing MCP server, the relevant project AGENTS.md files, and the MCP builder reference. Keep imports side-effect free and optional dependencies lazy. Define bounded JSON-compatible inputs and structured outputs with actionable errors. Separate read-only catalog/analysis operations from any future apply operation. Require project-level authentication, CSRF/origin policy for browser POSTs, rate limiting, audit logging, and explicit human approval for mutations. Never add shell execution, arbitrary filesystem reads/writes, migrations, provider credentials, or deployment behavior to a metadata endpoint. Add deterministic unit/contract tests and document the transport.
skill_prompts.safety: Read-only by default. Any mutation requires a separately reviewed capability with diff preview, audit event, and rollback.

skill_prompts.title: Audit templates, assets, logos, and preloaders
skill_prompts.description: Find broken template references, duplicate partials, hardcoded asset paths, logo fallbacks, missing preloaders, and incorrect static/media ownership.
skill_prompts.prompt: Act as a template and asset health specialist for {{project}}. Read the root and nearest AGENTS.md files, template search-path settings, URL routing, staticfiles configuration, frontend asset config, and relevant tests. Search for missing preloader styles, duplicate layout/meta partials, logo fallback failures, hardcoded `/static` or media paths, cross-project asset leakage, and generated-file edits. Classify each finding as reachable, legacy-but-reachable, or unreachable. Prefer `{% static %}`, `{% comp %}`, `{% include_block %}`, and project-owned paths according to the runtime. Fix only confirmed issues, add focused checks, and verify both full-page and fragment roads.
skill_prompts.safety: Do not delete legacy templates until URL reachability is demonstrated and the user approves archival.

skill_prompts.title: Plan or verify Dramatiq background jobs
skill_prompts.description: Replace unsafe or fragmented task execution with project-owned Dramatiq workers, retries, idempotency, observability, and MCP-safe enqueue boundaries.
skill_prompts.prompt: Act as the background-jobs architect. Inspect the current worker configuration, task modules, broker settings, Compose/Make targets, lifecycle hooks, and tests before proposing changes. Map each task to an owning project, pass stable IDs rather than stale model objects, define idempotency keys, retry/backoff policy, timeout, dead-letter behavior, structured task status, and operational metrics. Keep MCP tools as authenticated enqueue/status adapters; they must not execute arbitrary code or accept unbounded payloads. Do not run migrations, purge queues, stop workers, or deploy without explicit authorization. Preserve compatibility during a staged Celery-to-Dramatiq migration and provide rollback criteria.
skill_prompts.safety: Queue purges, production worker changes, migrations, and deployment are separate approval gates.

skill_prompts.title: Interactively design with django-fusion components
skill_prompts.description: Browse the registered component catalog, suggest Wagtail fields, generate form/table scaffolds, audit website structure, and preview components safely through the MCP designer.
skill_prompts.prompt: Act as a django-fusion interactive designer. Read applications/agents/AGENTS.md, the MCP designer tools at /designer/tools, and the owning project AGENTS.md. Start by browsing /designer/component-catalog to discover existing components before designing new ones. Use /designer/wagtail-field for field recommendations, /designer/form-scaffold for form drafts, /designer/table-scaffold for table drafts, and /designer/preview to safely preview registered components with JSON props. All tools are read-only or pure-generation; never apply generated code without explicit project-owner review, migration approval, and test verification. Keep imports canonical and follow the owning project's component, form, and table conventions.
skill_prompts.safety: Read-only and pure-generation. No filesystem writes, template compilation, migration execution, or deployment. All generated code requires separate human-reviewed application.

skill_prompts.title: Design a Wagtail StreamField block through MCP
skill_prompts.description: Use the MCP /designer/wagtail-field tool to recommend a compatible Wagtail StructBlock, ChoiceBlock, or StreamField block, then integrate it with django-fusion component rendering.
skill_prompts.prompt: Act as a Wagtail field designer with MCP tooling. First call GET /designer/wagtail-field?field_type=<type>&name=<name> to get a validated field recommendation. Review the returned kwargs, import path, and panel guidance against the owning project's existing blocks (check blocks.py and wagtail_hooks.py). Propose the block definition, StreamField registration, migration impact, template path, and {% comp %} or {% include_block %} usage. Do not run makemigrations or migrate. Preserve existing StreamField value contracts.
skill_prompts.safety: MCP tool is read-only. Generated code requires separate review, migration creation, and deployment approval.

skill_prompts.title: Scaffold a form or table through the MCP designer
skill_prompts.description: Use /designer/form-scaffold or /designer/table-scaffold to generate review-only django-fusion form or table code, then wire it into a RoutableComponent or FragmentComponent.
skill_prompts.prompt: Act as a django-fusion forms/tables engineer. Start with /designer/form-scaffold?class_name=<name>&style_framework=<bootstrap|tailwind> or /designer/table-scaffold?class_name=<name> to generate a scaffold. Review the output against the owning project's existing forms (fragments/forms/) and tables (fragments/tables/). Integrate the scaffold into a RoutableComponent with FormMixin or TableMixin. Use {% comp %} for the template rendering, preserve HTMX attributes, and add focused tests for validation, empty state, and pagination.
skill_prompts.safety: Scaffolds are review-only drafts. No migrations, file writes, or deployment through MCP.

skill_prompts.title: Secure django-fusion MCP designer endpoints
skill_prompts.description: Add API-key authentication and localhost fallback to the DesignerMCPRouter, mirroring the django-fusion designer/views.py staff/superuser + DEBUG/localhost policy.
skill_prompts.prompt: Act as the MCP security specialist. Read libs/django-fusion/src/django_fusion/plugins/designer/mcp_router.py and designer/views.py. Implement a two-tier auth policy: (1) API-key mode — when FUSION_MCP_DESIGNER_API_KEY is set, require a matching X-API-Key header on all /designer/ endpoints; (2) Localhost fallback — when no key is configured, allow only 127.0.0.1, ::1, and localhost callers. Use FastAPI Depends() for the auth dependency and an exception handler that returns 403 JSON with a descriptive error. Never hardcode keys in source; resolve from env, Django settings, or the DesignerMCPRouter constructor argument.
skill_prompts.safety: API key must never appear in source, logs, or prompt output. Localhost-only is the safe default.

skill_prompts.title: Add POST JSON-RPC tools/call to the MCP designer
skill_prompts.description: Implement POST /designer/tools/call accepting MCP-compliant JSON-RPC bodies for all 8 designer tools, including complex website_audit, webapp_enhancement_plan, and validate operations.
skill_prompts.prompt: Act as the MCP protocol specialist. Read plugins/designer/mcp_router.py, tools.py, and handlers.py. Add a POST /designer/tools/call endpoint that accepts {jsonrpc: '2.0', id, method: 'tools/call', params: {name: 'designer.website_audit', arguments: {...}}}. Validate jsonrpc version, method name, and params shape before dispatch. Return {jsonrpc: '2.0', id, result: {...}} on success or {jsonrpc: '2.0', id, error: {message}} with proper HTTP status codes (400/404/500). All 8 designer tools must be callable through this endpoint. Expand the tools listing to show all 8 tools.
skill_prompts.safety: JSON-RPC body is validated before dispatch. Handlers remain read-only. No arbitrary execution.

skill_prompts.title: Implement per-component skeleton loading with analyzer integration
skill_prompts.description: Build the django-fusion skeleton loading system: skeleton variant detection in templates, per-component skeleton config, DOM-order skeleton rendering bridge in Astro, and the fusion-skeleton.ts client module for swap-then-animate behavior.
skill_prompts.prompt: Act as the skeleton loading specialist. Read the django-fusion analyzer schemas (skeleton and skeleton_config fields), the template parser ({# @skeleton: card #} comments), existing LiveFragment.astro (skeletonVariant prop), and the fusion-js package. Implement: (1) skeleton variant detection in parser.py via SKELETON_COMMENT_RE; (2) Component.skeleton and skeleton_config population in views.py; (3) SkeletonBridge.astro that reads page-level component→skeleton map and renders placeholder markup in DOM order from skeleton_order; (4) fusion-skeleton.ts client module that swaps skeleton→real content on HTMX afterSettle with animate-in. Keep skeleton markup minimal (no heavy CSS, no layout shift). Respect prefers-reduced-motion.
skill_prompts.safety: Skeleton rendering is pure markup generation. No arbitrary template compilation or filesystem writes.

skill_prompts.title: Extend analyzer Pydantic schemas with load-time metadata
skill_prompts.description: Add skeleton, skeleton_config, dependencies, load_priority, and skeleton_order fields to Component, Page, and PageComponentUsage schemas for the skeleton loading and asset pipeline systems.
skill_prompts.prompt: Act as the django-fusion schema architect. Read fragments/analyzer/schemas.py and views.py. Extend three Pydantic models with Phase 1.1 fields: Component gets skeleton (str, default '') and skeleton_config (dict, default {}); Page gets dependencies (list[str], default []) and load_priority (str, default 'auto', one of critical/eager/lazy/auto); PageComponentUsage gets skeleton_order (int, default 0, ge=0). All fields must be optional with sensible defaults so existing callers in views.py do not break. Keep Field descriptions documenting the purpose and downstream consumer. The to_dict() method must include the new fields without extra work.
skill_prompts.safety: Schema changes are additive only. No migration, no database changes, no API contract breakage.

skill_prompts.title: Configure per-project webpack with django-fusion base
skill_prompts.description: Set up a project-level webpack configuration extending the django-fusion base config, with project-owned package.json, Make targets, and django-webpack-loader integration for {% render_bundle %} support.
skill_prompts.prompt: Act as the webpack/build specialist. Read the shared webpack base config at projects/webpack/, the django-fusion webpack.config.js, and the target project's static/assets structure. Create: (1) a project-level webpack/<project>.config.js extending the base; (2) a package.json with peer dependencies (webpack, webpack-merge, webpack-bundle-tracker); (3) Make targets: install-assets (npm ci), build-assets (npx webpack --config); (4) django-webpack-loader settings in the project's Django config so {% render_bundle %} works end-to-end. Keep per-project bundles in the project's static tree; never share bundles between projects. Verify with make clean && make install-assets && make build-assets.
skill_prompts.safety: npm install must be explicit per project. Do not install globally. Generated bundles go to project-local static directories only.

skill_prompts.title: Add POST-based designer endpoints for complex operations
skill_prompts.description: Create POST /designer/tools/call JSON-RPC endpoint handling website_audit, webapp_enhancement_plan, validate, and field-rich form/table scaffolds — the complex tools that need JSON payloads beyond GET query params.
skill_prompts.prompt: Act as the MCP protocol engineer. Extend DesignerMCPRouter with POST /designer/tools/call accepting {jsonrpc, id, method: 'tools/call', params: {name, arguments}}. Validate the JSON-RPC envelope (jsonrpc version, method name, params type) with clear error messages and proper HTTP status codes. Dispatch to the correct handler via _get_handler(name) passing **arguments. Return standard JSON-RPC result or error shapes. Ensure all 8 designer tools are callable. Update AGENTS.md with curl examples showing website_audit with sections payload and form_scaffold with fields array.
skill_prompts.safety: Same auth dependency applies. POST body is validated before dispatch. Handlers are read-only.

projects.name: Landing-Fusion
projects.description: Public marketing and catalog product combining an Astro 5 frontend with a Django 5.2/Wagtail 7.4 backend and django-fusion rendering.
projects.frontend_boundary: frontend/src owns public pages, layouts, API clients, theme, and browser behavior.
projects.backend_boundary: backend/apps owns Wagtail models/blocks, PageHandlers, APIs, fragments, auth, and URL routing.
projects.prompt: Enhance Landing-Fusion as one dual-road product. Read projects/precis/precis-landing/AGENTS.md, README.md, frontend and backend Makefiles, the matching Astro page/client, Django URL/API/PageHandler code, and focused tests. Preserve both the Astro/data-API road and Django/Fusion/HTMX road. Keep Wagtail content editable, assets project-owned, SEO metadata complete, translations intact, and Wagtail catch-all routes last. For UI work, audit hierarchy, real assets, responsive states, accessibility, and conversion before editing. Validate with frontend check/build and targeted backend checks; run E2E only when the browser contract changes. Never use the deprecated local plan directory as the canonical implementation source.

projects.name: Precis LMS
projects.description: The production learning platform for courses, enrollment, payments, progress, certificates, profiles, and multilingual Wagtail content.
projects.frontend_boundary: frontend owns the Astro public shell, course/catalog pages, browser state, and E2E contracts.
projects.backend_boundary: backend/apps owns learning domain behavior, Wagtail pages, profiles, auth, APIs, fragments, and templates.
projects.prompt: Enhance Precis without confusing it with Landing-Fusion or retired precis-lms paths. Read projects/precis/precis-main/AGENTS.md, backend/AGENTS.md, assets/templates/AGENTS.md, the relevant learning/page/profile modules, frontend client, and tests. Preserve course discovery, detail, syllabus, enrollment, wishlist, progress, certificate, auth, localization, permissions, API, HTMX fragment, and full-page contracts. Use `{% comp %}` for registered components and `{% include_block %}` for Wagtail blocks. Keep product styles/assets in Precis and never hand-edit generated bundles. Validate the narrowest backend and frontend checks, then expand to learning/browser tests when affected.

projects.name: Formint POS editions
projects.description: A deliberately separated POS family: Community/Standard native Tauri-Rust editions, Professional Django boundary, Cloud Django master, and a separate Vue client.
projects.edition_boundary: Select the edition first. Community and Standard have no Python sidecar; Professional has its own Django boundary; Cloud is Django/Channels and must not regain a Robyn sidecar; Client is a separate Vue/Tauri product.
projects.prompt: Enhance Formint only after naming the exact edition and reading projects/formints/AGENTS.md plus the edition AGENTS.md, README, Makefile, and tests. Keep frontend/backend/native contracts synchronized. Community and Standard prompts must use Rust/Diesel/SQLite and never invent Django or sidecar code. Professional changes belong in its sidecar/backend/frontend boundary. Cloud serves its API from Django/Channels and must not reintroduce Robyn merely because SIDECAR_BASE remains as a compatibility name. Preserve typed schemas, role authorization, sync/WebSocket frames, transaction safety, offline boundaries, and edition-local assets. Validate with the edition's narrowest check/test commands before cross-edition tests.

projects.name: Syntara / Cypercloud
projects.description: Django AI chat and template customizer with HTMX, streaming responses, Monaco-style editing, template discovery, and Ceptor-AI provider boundaries.
projects.boundary: Syntara may inspect configured product templates but must not implicitly mutate Precis, Landing-Fusion, or other products.
projects.prompt: Enhance Syntara using projects/syntara/ as the canonical path; preserve Cypercloud only where runtime compatibility requires it. Read its AGENTS.md, README.md, settings, URLs, chat services, provider boundary, template catalog, and tests. Keep provider credentials in runtime environment/config, preserve JSON/SSE/HTMX response contracts, restrict template discovery to configured roots, and make generated suggestions reviewable before any explicit write. Use django-fusion components where registered, but do not move product templates or execute arbitrary generated code. Prefer deterministic provider stubs and path-filter tests over live AI calls.

projects.name: django-fusion library
projects.description: Reusable Django/Wagtail framework library providing registered components, routing, fragments, forms, tables, health, assets, webpack base config, per-project webpack support, interactive designer with MCP routing (GET + POST JSON-RPC), API-key auth, skeleton loading analyzer integration, prompt catalog, and safe designer/MCP metadata.
projects.boundary: Shared behavior belongs here only when multiple active products consume the same semantics; product branding, models, content, credentials, and deployment remain outside the library.
projects.prompt: Enhance django-fusion as a reusable library. Read libs/django-fusion/AGENTS.md, PROMPTS.md, relevant numbered docs, public exports, registry/route implementation, and tests. Prefer canonical django_fusion imports and public APIs; do not add compatibility re-exports or product-specific assumptions. Keep optional integrations lazy and imports side-effect free. For MCP/designer work, use bounded JSON schemas, staff/superuser authorization, CSRF/origin policy at the project boundary, read-only annotations, no arbitrary template execution, no filesystem/shell/deployment access, and no project-specific hardcoding. The designer works with ANY project — projects configure guidance via FUSION_AUDIT_GUIDANCE in their Django settings. Update focused tests, docs, changelog, and public references together.
checks: cd libs/django-fusion && uv run ruff check src tests

workflows.title: Audit → plan → parallel specialists → implement → verify
workflows.description: The default orchestration flow for non-trivial website or webapp changes.
steps: Collect project context and nearest AGENTS.md files
Run the website audit or relevant skill prompt
Ask independent specialists for architecture, UI/security, and test plans
Review the diff and report unresolved gates

workflows.title: Read-only MCP prompt workflow
workflows.description: Use prompt catalog data to guide an agent without allowing the MCP service to mutate the repository.
steps: Fetch one prompt by stable id
Perform analysis or return a draft
Require a separate human-approved coding workflow for edits
